sources.snippet: The RS-LLaVA model is based on the architecture of the LLaVA model [15]. In our experiments, we explore two variants of pre-trained Vicuna-v1.5 [60] LLM variants, ranging in size from 7B to 13B, to initialize the language model for RS-LLaVA.
